note: Pairs from petrascyll hsr_fix.py (1.4 to 3.0, GitHub copy of the 3.0C script) plus extra pairs from the SR-Model-Importer-Assets history for versions after it. The 3.2 pipeline change and the 3.3 fix are structural ini rewrites; they are described in rules but their data is not copied (CC BY-NC-ND). The assets history before 1.4 (commits of 2023-05 and 2023-08) is the 1.2 block, first in the list: blocks are ordered oldest first and a chain only moves to a later block. The 15 Kafka pairs of commit e53e2647 (2023-08-17) are left out: they relabel her first dump (hair and head swapped, other characters' textures listed as hers) eight days after her release, so no game update is behind them. Pairs form chains; "from" is the version label of the old hash. Old hashes of HSR are character and part specific, key by character and part.

rules.detail: Vertex explosion fix. Some body Position buffers need a second position hash. When the ini has a TextureOverride for hash and none of copy_for is in the ini (or already used), copy that section as a second TextureOverride for copy_for[0]. Ini text edit only. Entries also carry the version in which the extra hash appeared.

IB split after a mesh part change. For the IB TextureOverride(s) with hash trigger_hash: take the old sections (one per match_first_index, plus an unindexed one), and write new sections for hash new_hash, one per trg_indices entry i, with "match_first_index = trg_indices[i]". Its body is copied from the old section whose match_first_index equals src_indices[i]; src_indices[i] = -1 means there is no old part, write "ib = null" instead. Also keep an unindexed IB section (hash only) that holds the non indexed content. Section titles: <Name>Body then A, B, C. Ini text edit only.

Welt body texcoord buffer, two steps. 1.6 -> 2.0 (hash 723e0365 -> 0ab3a636): add TEXCOORD1 by copying the last two half floats of every vertex: struct "<BBBBee" (8 bytes) becomes "<BBBBeeee" (12 bytes), the new pair equals the old last pair. 2.0 -> 2.1 (0ab3a636 -> 381a994e): convert halves to floats: "<BBBBeeee" (12) -> "<BBBBffff" (20). In both steps update stride in the vb1 Resource and comment the old value.

Trailblazer path variants. Destruction, Preservation and Harmony have separate model hashes. For each entry: if the ini already contains any hash in if_any_of_present, comment out the section with this hash (the mod already supports that path), otherwise update it to new. After the hash update the section is duplicated per path by the IB split rule above. Ini text edit only.

3.2 "Batched Pose" pipeline change (needs XXMI 0.6.6+ and SRMI 2.0.0+, SRMI 2.1.0 for the converter). The GameBanana post says the fix has to make major edits to the structure of the ini, so it is not a hash swap. What it does, from the post and the Pipeline Convert Fix post: (1) hook the Blend hash instead of the Position hash (position -> blend hook with draw = <vertex count>), (2) remove the old ResourceDrawCS / DrawBuffer references and the "DRAW_TYPE == 8" compute shader branch, bind PositionBuffer and BlendBuffer resources and set $\SRMI\vertex_count = <count> instead, (3) rename Draw related vars. A table of known (blend, draw, position) hash trios per model part drives it (VALID_HASH_TRIOS, 15 KB json). Both tools are CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 on GameBanana (petrascyll hsr_fix33d, Gustav0_ Pipeline Convert Fix), so the code and trio table were not copied. The ini rewrite is exact text work but large, mark it "use the upstream tool" until an engineer reads a licence friendly source.

ps-t slots to RabbitFX "Stable Textures". Old HSR mods bind textures by raw ps-t slot, which jumps around between updates. The script rewrites those lines to the RabbitFX stable texture resources, so the mod no longer depends on hunted hashes. Needs SRMI RabbitFX. License MIT (script 3 KB on GameBanana tool 22998, fix_rabbitmods.zip). The script was not downloaded or read, only its description.

upstream.notes: PlayerCharacterData/<Name>/hash.json: array of components {component_name, root_vs, draw_vb, position_vb, blend_vb, texcoord_vb, ib, object_indexes, object_classifications, texture_hashes}. Walk commits that touch a hash.json, fetch both blobs, diff by component_name. HSR 3.2+ hooks Blend instead of Position, so blend_vb is the trigger hash for current mods. Last push 2026-01-01.
{"<Character><Part>": ["blend_hash","draw_hash","position_hash"]}, used by the 3.2 position to blend rewrite. No licence stated; read at run time rather than ship it.
_aFiles[] and _tsDateModified show when a newer HSR fix is posted. The last file is 2025-06-10, so nothing newer exists as of 2026-11-13.
